about: Each story carries a one-line read of what it means for one of four segments: CVs (electric buses, trucks and light commercial vehicles), EVs (electric cars, two- and three-wheelers), batteries (cells, packs, lithium and cell materials) or BESS (battery energy storage systems). Tags show the direction: lower or higher battery costs, more or less demand, competition, supply and policy. Written each morning with the news; a quick first read, not analysis.

segments.CVs: Electric buses, trucks and light commercial vehicles, their makers, fleet orders, tenders, charging and swapping.
segments.EVs: Electric cars, two- and three-wheelers and their makers.
segments.Batteries: Cells, packs and BMS, lithium and cell materials, and the companies that make them.
segments.BESS: Battery energy storage systems: tenders, projects, prices and makers.

focus: India first, then China (the main source of cells and materials), then the rest of the world. Commercial vehicles (e-buses, e-trucks) and grid storage matter most.

keys.cost: Battery costs: cells and the lithium and materials inside them.
keys.demand: Demand for CVs, EVs, batteries or storage systems.
keys.competition: New makers, capacity or products entering a market.
keys.supply: How easily cells and materials can be obtained.
